acceptance: Reproduce Codex CLI v0.144.6 failing before auth/quota evaluation because models_cache.json lacks supports_reasoning_summaries, while the separately configured Codex2 cache and quota group remain healthy.

Treat the exact model-cache schema parse signature as local cache compatibility, never as credential revocation or account equivalence; do not read, rewrite, copy, rotate, or expose auth.json or API keys.

Outside runtime-admission and canonical locks, atomically quarantine only the exact affected provider-home models cache with inode/hash/mtime evidence, then perform one bounded fresh live probe; ambiguous paths remain fail closed and no whole-fleet probe is allowed.

Classify the observed Codex usage-limit response as quota_reached, capture a sanitized reset timestamp when present, and persist it through existing provider capability and dispatch-pause APIs rather than hand-editing JSON.

While Codex is quota-blocked, atomically rebind only eligible task owner/reviewer pairs to healthy configured targets; preserve dependency, priority, capacity, cooldown, failure-loop, chair-triage, active lease and exact-head review gates.

Codex and Codex2 remain separate configured account and quota groups. Do not hardcode same-account equivalence and do not add a global mutual-review ban; current task-scoped live availability and independent-review evidence remain authoritative.

A fresh successful probe after the recorded reset clears only the affected provider pause; failed, timeout, revoked, quota, malformed-cache or ambiguous probes remain closed without consuming a worker.

Regression matrix covers compatible cache, exact incompatible cache, unsafe/unowned cache path, concurrent probes, quarantine failure, refresh success, quota with/without reset timestamp, auth revoked, timeout, and distinct Codex/Codex2 routing.

Use a clean task worktree from current origin/dev, commit only declared scope, run focused and full relevant provider/supervisor tests, py_compile, JSON, diff and trailer checks, open PR to dev, obtain exact-head Human/Ops review, merge and canonical archive.

No live service restart or production deployment belongs to this source task. A governed canary later proves cache recovery, quota pause, distinct-group fallback and rollback; rollback is merge revert and restoring the quarantined cache only if needed.
